Priyom —

Short answer: yes, AWS supports 12/24/36 month private offers. A few operational notes and our recommended path below.

Checklist / recommended options (for buyer packet):
1) Supported terms & typical pricing guidance:
   - 12 months: standard list pricing, straightforward (no seller leadership approval).
   - 24 months: acceptable; recommend 6–10% off list if buyer commits to annual billing or upfront payment.
   - 36 months: needs stronger justification; typical discounts 12–18% depending on ARR and payment cadence.

2) Internal approval gates (Redwood):
   - Discounts <= 8% and term <= 24 months: handled by account team + finance ops (no executive approval).
   - Discounts > 8% or term == 36 months or total contract value > $250k: requires Sales Director approval + Finance sign-off.
   - Any T&Cs that deviate from standard AWS private offer templates require Legal review (allow 2–3 business days).

3) Operational timeline:
   - Once buyer signs and returns PO: ~1 business day for Seller to create AWS Private Offer draft, 1–3 business days for AWS Seller Support to publish after validation. Assume 3–5 business days end-to-end in normal cases.

4) Billing cadence:
   - We support monthly invoicing via Redwood billing for private offers (default), or annual advance invoicing if requested (preferred if buyer wants lower price).

5) Docs & next steps:
   - Attach our AWS Private Offer checklist (Redwood-AWS-Private-Offer-Checklist.xlsx). Use this to populate the buyer packet.
   - If you plan to propose >8% off or 36-month term, loop in Laura for Director approval (cc'd) and mention expected TV (estimated ARR).

Suggested language for buyer packet: "Redwood supports 12/24/36 month private offers via AWS Marketplace. For a 24-month commitment we can offer an 8% discount with monthly billing; 36-month requests may be eligible for an additional discount subject to Sales Director approval."

If you want, I can pre-approve an 8% discount for this deal (RDW-2483) if the buyer picks 24 months and agrees to annual or upfront payment.

-Vanessa

Hi Helen — thanks for the PO (attached). Per internal guidance, here are three clean options you can present to your CFO/procurement team:

Option A — 12 months (standard) - Pricing: list price - Billing cadence: monthly - Approvals: no Redwood leadership approval needed

Option B — 24 months (recommended for cost benefit) - Pricing: ~8% off list if billed annually or prepaid; ~6% off if monthly billing - Billing cadence: annual prepay preferred; monthly available - Approvals: within account team (Vanessa has pre-approved up to 8% for RDW-2483)

Option C — 36 months (requires approval) - Pricing: 12–15% off list, requires Sales Director + Finance sign-off

Next steps if you select Option B (24 months):
1) Confirm billing preference (annual upfront vs monthly).
2) Sign and return updated PO template (I've attached an updated draft: Acme_PO_Draft_v3.pdf).
